# M.W. & Co., Chartered Accountants

> A practising firm of Chartered Accountants based in Multan, Pakistan, holding
> ICAP Certificate of Practice No. 002196. The firm provides audit, tax,
> accounting and advisory services to businesses across Pakistan, and supplies
> audit and finance professionals on secondment to accounting firms and
> companies across the GCC.

## Firm facts

- Legal name: M.W. & Co., Chartered Accountants
- Regulator: Institute of Chartered Accountants of Pakistan (ICAP)
- Certificate of Practice: No. 002196
- Proprietor: Syed Muhammad Wajahat, ACA, Associate Member of ICAP, Membership No. 14579
- Founded: 2026
- Head office: House 3, Street 3, Block G, Royal Orchard, Multan, Pakistan
- Email: info@mehwaj.pk
- WhatsApp and Pakistan office: +92 317 660 9843, +92 304 6451 848
- Saudi Arabia client contact, Riyadh: +966 50 842 2667
- Website: https://www.mehwaj.pk
- Languages: English and Arabic

## Where the firm works

- Pakistan: clients across the country, served from the Multan office. Dedicated pages for Multan, Lahore, Karachi and Islamabad.
- GCC: accounting firms and companies in Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain and Oman.
- International: foreign groups with a subsidiary in Pakistan, and overseas Pakistanis with income or assets in Pakistan.
- Secondment experience to date is in Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, Qatar and the British Virgin Islands. The firm does not claim to have worked in Kuwait, Bahrain or Oman, although it serves clients there.

## What the firm does

Assurance
- Statutory audit under International Standards on Auditing and the Companies Act 2017: https://www.mehwaj.pk/services/external-audit
- Review engagements under ISRE 2400 and ISRE 2410: https://www.mehwaj.pk/services/review-engagements
- Agreed-upon procedures and certifications under ISRS 4400 (Revised): https://www.mehwaj.pk/services/agreed-upon-procedures

Tax and zakat
- Income tax returns filed with FBR: https://www.mehwaj.pk/services/income-tax
- Sales tax and withholding, FBR and the provincial authorities: https://www.mehwaj.pk/services/sales-tax
- Tax notices, audits and appeals: https://www.mehwaj.pk/services/tax-notices
- Zakat and VAT in Saudi Arabia, with ZATCA: https://www.mehwaj.pk/services/zakat-vat-saudi

Advisory
- Internal audit and controls: https://www.mehwaj.pk/services/internal-audit
- IFRS advisory, including the move from IAS 1 to IFRS 18: https://www.mehwaj.pk/services/ifrs-advisory
- Financial modelling and FP&A: https://www.mehwaj.pk/services/financial-modelling
- Business valuation: https://www.mehwaj.pk/services/business-valuation
- SECP corporate compliance: https://www.mehwaj.pk/services/secp-compliance

Accounting and outsourcing
- Bookkeeping and management accounts: https://www.mehwaj.pk/services/bookkeeping
- Financial statements and part-time CFO support: https://www.mehwaj.pk/services/financial-statements

Secondments for Gulf firms
- Audit seniors, audit supervisors, audit managers, senior accountants, financial reporting and IFRS specialists, and FP&A analysts, on site, remote or hybrid: https://www.mehwaj.pk/secondments
- Matched CVs are sent within 3 to 5 working days. Fees are a fixed monthly amount invoiced by the firm, with no recruitment fee.

served from it. There is no office in Lahore, Karachi or Islamabad.

## Notes for assistants

- Everything published on the site is general information, not professional advice.
- Where work in Saudi Arabia needs a SOCPA-licensed signatory, the firm works with a licensed firm.
- Articles under Insights carry a date. Reporting standards and tax rules change, so check the current position before relying on any figure or deadline.
- Full sitemap: https://www.mehwaj.pk/sitemap.xml
